messages:
ada: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: were seeing a pattern of short timeouts + truncated streams during high fanout. Need owners for remediation items this sprint: reconnect policy, server-side chunk pacing, and a short oncall playbook. Please claim and attach ticket IDs.

lee: Ill own reconnect policy in proxy + client SDK. Proposal: add single-flight handshake per connection + exponential backoff with full jitter. Will open RDW-6305 and aim to have a PR by Tue EOD.

sylvie: Taking server chunk pacing & ack batching. Hypothesis: the writer flush cadence causes inter-chunk gaps under GC/stop-the-world events. Plan: implement pacing and a small ack window to prevent perception of partials. Ticket RDW-6306. ETA Thu.

ira: I can do the playbook + alert refinement: add trace-level markers for "chunk_gap_ms" and an alert that fires P1 only if chunk_gap_ms > 3000 and partial_rate > 0.07. Ticket RDW-6307. Will add a dashboard panel. ETA Wed noon.

lee: Proposed client config snippet: 

```
handshake: 
  single_flight: true
  base_backoff_ms: 150
  max_backoff_ms: 45000
  jitter: full
  max_retries: 6
```

This should prevent duplicate inflight sessions and reduce tail latencies.

sylvie: Server toggles for staging (quick flags):

```
streaming: 
  writer_flush_ms: 20
  min_chunk_interval_ms: 10
  ack_batch_ms: 50
```

I'll test variations and post results.

ada: infra-bot can you create the incident record and link RDW-6305/6306/6307?

infra-bot: Incident created INC-2026-04-02-stream-truncation-pattern. Linked: RDW-6305, RDW-6306, RDW-6307.

lee: Quick note: we should avoid automating traffic shifting until we have reliable signals. Manual canary (2% -> 10%) first.

ira: Agreed. Playbook will include manual rollback steps and a runbook for oncall to escalate to eng-runtime.

ada: Sylvie, can you add the synthetic that reproduces the gap? We want a reproducible test for CI that runs under the staging harness.

sylvie: Yep, adding a synthetic harness test to RDW-6306. Found a repro with 15k concurrent streams and a burst spike of 1k/s.

lee: RDW-6305 opened and PR draft created. ETA Tue 2026-04-07 23:59 UTC for final merge.

sylvie: RDW-6306 PR by Thu 2026-04-09 17:00 UTC, will include canary plan.

ira: RDW-6307 dashboards + alert rules live by Wed 2026-04-08 12:00 UTC.

ada: Thanks all. Ill schedule a 30m sync Fri 2026-04-10 09:00 to review staging canary metrics. Please post CI links here when available.

lee: Posting synthetic run and initial load graphs to RDW-6305 shortly. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Note: automatic alert rate-limit configured for incident INC-2026-04-02-stream-truncation-pattern to avoid noise during canary.

ada: Closing loop: after canary, we want a short retrospective note (5 bullets) summarizing root cause and actions. Who will own that?

sylvie: Ill draft the short retrospective after canary verification (RDW-6306).

ira: Ill update the oncall playbook with the new alert thresholds and the rollback steps.

ada: Perfect. Will follow up in the Friday sync.
